definitions.case_probability: arithmetic mean of all evaluated view probabilities; metrics computed per seed, then summarized
definitions.case_dice: arithmetic mean of evaluated image Dice values; 224x224 letterbox valid pixels
definitions.D: Brier_step2 - Brier_step4; positive means lower step4 Brier
definitions.S: Dice_step4 - Dice_step2; positive means higher step4 Dice
definitions.model_minus_baseline_brier: Brier_model - Brier_baseline; negative favors the model
definitions.seed_std: sample standard deviation with ddof=1 over the three fitted training seeds
definitions.case_bootstrap: average the three seed-specific effects within each aligned Case, then resample Cases

limitations: Development-only screening does not establish clinical benefit, causal mechanism or novelty.
The bootstrap conditions on these fitted models and fixed observed cohort; it does not estimate training-seed sampling uncertainty.
Three seeds give descriptive direction and spread only, not generalizability over training randomness.
Case-to-patient mapping is unverified; patient independence is not established.
Only train/tune predictions are accepted; calibration/test performance is not measured.
Frozen features, no augmentation, fixed learning rate and resized Dice limit the scope of this screen.
